## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all 4 pipeline stages (`Synthesizing/Fetching Market Data`, `Computing Active Indicator`, `Simulating Monte Carlo Surrogates`, `Evaluating Hilbert Phase-Jerk Frontier & Pine v6 Transpiler`) explicitly defined with their respective weight ranges? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK004 Is the per-surrogate progress formula in Stage 3 mathematically specified (`40% + 45% * (i / N)`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK005 Are design tokens (surface `#1A1D24`, border `#2D313E`, gradient `#7C4DFF -> #FF4B4B`, success `#21C354`, pending `#6E7687`, amber warning `#F59E0B`, shimmer `#161922 -> #1F2430`) explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Plan §Summary, Contracts §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the warm-state chart dimming behavior quantified with exact CSS properties (`45%` opacity and `blur(1px)`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are mid-run sidebar parameter modifications addressed with a specific status badge requirement (`"Restarted pipeline with updated parameters"`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Are long-running computation thresholds (`bars > 1500`, `n_surrogates > 60`, or `elapsed > 15.0s`) and warning visuals defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 Are step-level partial failure diagnostics (`✕`, `"Failed at Step {k}: {message}"`) and recovery actions (`Retry Run`, `Reset to Default Seed`, `Cancel Run`) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]

## Accessibility & Responsive Layout Requirements

- [x] CHK010 Are responsive breakpoint rules (`>= 1024px` 4-column grid, `768px–1023px` 2x2 grid, `< 768px` 1-column stack) and collapsed-sidebar parameter context pills defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Are ARIA region/progressbar attributes and stage-transition-only `aria-live="polite"` throttling (`<= 5` announcements per run) specified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK012 Are `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` fallback requirements specified for shimmer skeletons and spinners? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
